name: Kumamoto (Japan)
description: A bright green field charged at the centre with the Kumamoto city emblem in white: a bold ring-shaped mark open at the side, a stylised rendering of the character 九.

features.role: Kumamoto city emblem — a stylised 九 in near-circular form
features.symbolism: stylises 九 (nine), alluding to Kumamoto's place in Kyūshū ('nine provinces')
